decision: Lifecycle artifacts under xbrief/ are shared, tracked repository state. No per-clone ignore mechanism may hide a lifecycle root.

governingRule.description: #1144 hybrid: selective per-file ignores are permitted; blanket directory ignores are not

alternativesConsidered.option: Treat active/ as per-maintainer work-in-progress and let each clone suppress it locally
Move the suppression to .gitignore so every clone shares it

whyWinner: 406 commits have touched xbrief/active/ and 543 distinct active-brief paths have been committed, so shared tracking is the established practice, not an accident. The swarm design requires it: a parent cannot monitor leaves whose briefs it cannot see. Per-clone suppression makes identical commands behave differently between maintainers, which is the hardest drift class to diagnose -- found here only by accident, three weeks after the fact.
revisitTrigger: Someone names a concrete case where hiding a lifecycle root is correct; that would require a documented opt-out in the #3505 detector
